Our stay at Azure by Yelken involved 5 adults and a 15-month-old child. Overall, the experience was mixed — the hotel has some very strong points, but unfortunately also several serious issues, mainly regarding cleanliness and room standards. Upon check-in, we were given rooms on the top (3rd) floor, and the condition of the rooms was honestly shocking. They appeared to still be under renovation rather than newly renovated. There was construction dust everywhere, styrofoam pieces on the floor, equipment wrapped in foil, and visible plaster and renovation residue throughout the rooms. The conditions were simply not suitable for guests to stay in. Although the rooms were recently renovated, the work was done very carelessly. Water leaked from the shower due to poor drainage and incorrectly installed shower screens. The hot water from the sink was brown. Ventilation systems were covered in thick dust, the air conditioning did not work, and the new TVs were not configured. There was initially no internet access, and even the refrigerators, telephones, and safes were not functioning until we complained directly to the hotel manager. We specifically chose this hotel because it advertised facilities for small children, yet there was no baby cot prepared despite our request. The cot was only delivered on the second day after asking approximately five times. The rooms were later cleaned, but unfortunately the cleaning quality was extremely poor — perhaps 2/10. It looked like only the middle of the room had been cleaned while the rest was ignored. Hallways throughout the hotel were also dirty, covered with plaster dust and renovation marks. Even after cleaning attempts, the dirt remained visible on floors and skirting boards. We had to ask for duvets, and after 2 days cleaning service brought two of them, new, packed in foil and toss it on the bed. Without bed linen. We had to ask about it the next day. Unacceptable in every other hotel we’ve been to. Honestly, this standard of cleanliness would be unacceptable in many European hotels. Poor cleanliness stayed the same through all our 10 day stay. On the second day of our stay, the ants invided our rooms. Cleaning staff didn’t do anything about it. Dead ants which we got rid off ourselves, stayed on the room floor til the 10th day.
